steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each score is placed by its sample size against the minimum of 30.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 score is reported on too small a sample

findings.title: Score reported on a sample below 30
findings.fix: Withhold the score or add responses

findings.title: Change reported with no sample size
findings.fix: Add the sample size beside the change

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] csat-chat.csv:12  Score reported on a sample below 30.
       Fix: Withhold the score or add responses.
[medium] csat-trend.csv:19  Change reported with no sample size.
       Fix: Add the sample size beside the change.
[low] csat-web.csv:26  NPS by channel not aggregated.
       Fix: Aggregate the channel results.
Not checked: Survey design; response bias.
pros: Checks a score reported with a sample below the minimum (default 30), and a change reported with no sample size.
cons: Not checked: Survey design; response bias.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-cs-csat-report skill on the records for this review.
